name: Universidad de Huelva
overview:
ADDITIONAL PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS


Students must demonstrate a B2 level in Spanish via an interview with a Spanish speaker (organized by IAFF team) in order to include this destination in their choices


______________________________________________________________________



The University of Huelva is a young and dynamic institution, striving toward excellence and a bright future for its 12,000 students. Located in the province of Huelva, in the south-west of Spain, between sea and mountains, it is at the center of a historically multicultural territory.


Its motto is "Sapere Aude", or: "Dare to know."


Since the university became independent from that of Seville in 1993, it has grown and has become one of the most dynamic universities in Spain. Its new facilities demonstrate this and have given its campus a much more modern image.


Numerous degrees are offered in its schools and faculties, and thanks to its high-level education and the quality of its services, the University of Huelva has seen its enrollment greatly increase in recent years.


Huelva is an ideal place to study; for its efforts in providing high quality education, its geographical location and its way of life, which make a year in this university a complete and unforgettable experience.


For advice to travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Spain, click here.
administrative:
1) Application dossier


Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).


If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.


To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa


For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).


For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.


Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance


For European students


The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe. To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.


For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger


For non-European students


You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.


Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/ public / login.html
accomodation: For further information on university life and life in general in Huelva, see the student guide: http://www.uhu.es/english/erasmusplusincoming/doc/EHUELVA01_International_Student_Guide.pdf
courses:
You must obtain 30 ECTS credits per semester, i.e. 60 ECTS credits over the year.


The courses are taught in Spanish (very few courses in English), so you need a B2 level in Spanish.


The semester dates are as follows: from mid-September to the end of June of the following year.


There are very few courses in IT, but courses in business management related to engineering.


The full offer can be found here. Go to Academic Information → Asignaturas en Español.


International students are not first for courses in English.


Courses in Spanish (3rd and 4th year courses – look at column C to see the years).


Please note:


IT courses are given on the La Rábida campus, outside of Huelva, at the following address:


Campus "La Rábida"


Carretera Huelva - Palos de la Frontera.


21819. La Rábida - Palos de la Frontera. Huelva


We remind you that attendance is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.


The course list is given to you for information purposes. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.


EIP: Any Tech4 abroad involves an EIP! Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
cost:
Estimated Budget:


  • Ticket: Paris–Seville around 120 € (round trip with Vueling) + around 10 € Seville–Huelva (train) or 7 € by bus.
  • Insurance: European "Améli" insurance card (free).
  • Housing: 180–250 € / month in shared apartment.
  • Food: Meal in the school cafeteria: 4.50 €
  • Transport: One city bus trip: € 1.10
  • Cinema: € 6 (special prices on Wednesday and Thursday)


These prices are indicative, and may vary.
